Combinator.description_en:
The logical relationship between rules at the same level. Valid values:
AND: All rules at the same level must be hit.
OR: Any one rule at the same level can be hit
Combinator.description_zh:
同层规则之间的逻辑关系。取值：
AND：同层规则需全部命中。
OR：同层规则命中任意一条即可
Combinator.title: combinator

Name.description_en: The endpoint device attribute field to match. Required for leaf rules
Name.description_zh: 待匹配的终端设备属性字段。叶子规则必填
Name.title: name

Operator.description_en: The matching operator. Required for leaf rules
Operator.description_zh: 匹配算子。叶子规则必填
Operator.title: operator

Rules.description_en: The list of matching rules. At least one rule must be included
Rules.description_zh: 匹配规则列表。至少包含1条规则

items.description_en: The matching rule. For leaf rules, Name, Operator, and Values are required. For group rules, Combinator and nested Rules are required
items.description_zh: 匹配规则。叶子规则须填写Name、Operator和Values；分组规则须填写Combinator和嵌套的Rules

Rules.title: rules

Values.description_en: The set of values to match. Required for leaf rules and cannot be empty
Values.description_zh: 待匹配的值集合。叶子规则必填且不允许为空
Values.title: values

description_en: Queries the list of device groups under the current Alibaba Cloud account by using paging
description_zh: 分页查询当前阿里云账号下的设备组列表
name: ListDeviceGroups

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 10000
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时显示的当前页的页码。取值：1~10000
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 500
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页数量。取值：1~500
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The device label name. The name can be up to 128 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 设备标签名称。长度不超过128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The collection of device group IDs. Duplicate values are not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 设备组ID集合，不允许重复
parameters.name: device_group_ids

DynamicOperator.description_en: The rule operator of the dynamic device group

DynamicRule.description_en: The matching rule of the dynamic device label
DynamicRule.description_zh: 动态设备标签的匹配规则

GroupType.description_en:
The device label type. Valid values:
static: A static device label. Members consist of manually added terminal devices.
dynamic: A dynamic device label. Members are automatically calculated by matching rules when terminal devices report heartbeats
GroupType.description_zh:
设备标签类型。取值：
static：静态设备标签，成员由手动添加的终端设备构成。
dynamic：动态设备标签，成员由匹配规则在终端设备上报心跳时自动计算

IsDefault.description_en:
Indicates whether the device label is a system built-in device label. Valid values:
true: A system built-in device label.
false: A user-defined device label
IsDefault.description_zh:
是否为系统内置设备标签。取值：
true：系统内置设备标签。
false：用户自定义设备标签

MatchDevTags.description_en: The collection of terminal device IDs associated with the device label
MatchDevTags.description_zh: 设备标签已关联的终端设备ID集合

items.description_en: The terminal device ID associated with the device label
items.description_zh: 设备标签已关联的终端设备ID

TotalNum.description_en: The total number of device labels
